messages:
Sasha: FYI nightly eval fails on the long-context suite for q8_0-2026-03-19 build — truncates instructions after ~12k tokens. Repro steps and logs below.

Olivia: Ugh. Which eval dashboard? link?

ml-ci-bot: nightly-eval: model=q8_0-2026-03-19, suite=long_context, p95_loss ↑ 0.32 -> 0.49, failures=82/500 (see: https://ci.redwood/local/nightly/long_context)

Sasha: Minimal failing sample pasted below. Expected full multi-step answer but model stops mid-instruction.
```
PROMPT: <system> You are an assistant. Follow the 3-step procedure below using the 14k-token chat history attached...
EXPECTED: Step 1: ... Step 2: ... Step 3: verify and return results.
MODEL OUT: Step 1: initialized. Step 2: run the
<eof>
```

Hector: That looks like a KV cache / prefix eviction problem. Might be anchor/session fragmentation where older slots get evicted mid-generation.

James: Can you paste runtime logs (runtime.log) around the failure? Any WARN or ERROR lines about kv_index or slot wrap?

Sasha: Log snippet from the failing run:
```
[2026-03-19T02:10:12Z] WARN kv_store: slot_start=24576 slot_end=65536 seq=18446744073709551615
[2026-03-19T02:10:12Z] ERROR runtime: kv_index out of range for session=session-7a3f
```

Olivia: That seq value looks like a u64 wrap (2^64-1). Not normal. Could be an unsigned underflow when computing anchor offsets.

Hector: Agreed. We had a similar symptom once when the anchor masking logic changed in the new kernel path (post-quantize). I suspect commit that introduced the new quant kernels also subtly changed how we compute session deltas.

Sasha: Repro command I used on my laptop:
```
./bin/eval_run --model q8_0-2026-03-19 --prompt-file tests/longctx/14k.json --max-tokens 1024 --session-id session-7a3f --enable-kv-checks
```
It reliably truncates on my devgpu after ~12k tokens. With `--enable-kv-checks` it logs the ERROR above.

James: I'll start a bisect between q8_0-2026-03-15 (last good) and q8_0-2026-03-19 to find the offending commit. If it's in the kernel selection/offset masking code it'll show up fast.

Olivia: Short-term mitigation: can we set `kv-prefix-preserve=true` in the nightly config so the runner keeps full prefix and avoids eviction? That will increase memory but will reduce noisy failures tomorrow. I can patch nightly config.

Sasha: I've drafted PR #4123 that tightens the masking and adds a unit test simulating anchor wrap. It also adds an extra assert in `kv_store::fetch()` to catch negative deltas earlier.

ml-ci-bot: CI queued: PR #4123 (run: unit + integration + nightly-sim).

Hector: I'll take ownership of reproducer and try to produce a small C++ unit test that reproduces the wrap without a 14k payload — helps speed CI.

James: Bisect started. First breakpoint shows 2026-03-17 commit `runtime: switch to quantized kernel selection v2` as suspect. Running narrower now.

Olivia: I'll apply the `kv-prefix-preserve=true` toggle to tomorrow's nightly and add a note on the dashboard to exclude p95 spikes until we have a fix. Also will add an alert rule to post to #incidents if failures >50.

Sasha: Plan summary: 1) James bisects to exact commit, 2) Hector builds a small unit repro and test, 3) Land PR #4123 if CI passes, 4) Re-run nightly with patched build and preserved prefix. Owners: Hector (repro/test), James (bisect), Olivia (nightly config), Sasha (PR/coord).

Olivia: ACK. Scheduling a 30m sync in 15m in case bisect finds immediate root cause.

James: Will post bisect result here once narrowed.

Sasha: Thanks all — please keep updates in this thread so I can attach to the eval regression ticket. :thumbsup:
